description: App icon: a cyan paddle and a glowing ball on a dark court.
Boot splash: the game name over the dark court with a paddle and ball.
Font of all text in Korean and English; bold and readable at large score sizes.

description: Menu BGM: a calm synth loop with a light pulse that hints at the match ahead.
Click of a UI button in every screen.
A paddle hits the ball in the match: a short bright blip.
The ball bounces off the top or bottom wall in the match: a short low blip.
The ball leaves the center for a new rally: a soft rising tick.
The player scores a point: a bright rising two-note chime.
The CPU scores a point: a short falling buzz.
The player wins the match: a short triumphant synth fanfare.
The player loses the match: a short falling synth phrase.
Title scene of the boot with the game name.
Menu scene after sign-in.
Match scene: the court with both paddles and the ball.
Root panel of the menu with the start and option buttons and the record.
Option panel over the menu with the account and document entries.
Root panel of the match: scores, rally count, match point and the control hint.
Result panel over the match with the score and the rematch and menu buttons.
Pause popup over the match with resume and menu buttons.
Loading screen of every scene transition.
Terms popup of the first sign-in.
Bright mark on a paddle where the ball hit it: holds for a moment and fades.
Squash of a paddle when it hits the ball.
Pop of a score number when it goes up.
White flash of the court when a point is scored.
